newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro traders say India bought Aug/Oct/Dec wheat.
newsitem.headline: Euro traders say India bought Aug/Oct/Dec wheat.

text.p: India is widely believed to have bought a million tonnes of Australian wheat this week, European grain traders said, echoing comments by U.S. exporters while stressing there was no official confirmation yet.
European traders said the shipment dates were August and October for 250,000 tonnes each and December for 500,000 tonnes.

"Everyone is saying the same thing, that India bought. But we still have to wait for the official government confirmation," one European exporter said, adding however that he had direct word of the purchase from Indian grain sources.
U.S. and European traders said the deals were done at $154.25 to $155 per tonne, Fob.
